description: Analytical data model (formerly 'Power BI dataset') that defines tables, relationships, measures, and calculations. Queried via DAX. Direct Lake mode reads Delta tables directly from OneLake (zero-copy); Import mode loads data into memory. Reports bind to semantic models for visualization.

definition_parts.description: Required entry point. MS schema requires $schema + version. fabio sends {"$schema":".../semanticModel/definitionProperties/1.0.0/schema.json","version":"4.0"} for TMDL and version "3.0" for model.bim; Fabric normalizes the stored version (e.g. to 4.2).
TMDL: one file per table with columns/measures/partitions
Import: full tabular model JSON (compatibilityLevel 1604, powerBI_V3)

flags.--connection: SQL Analytics Endpoint ID for Direct Lake binding

notes: Direct Lake REQUIRES TMDL format (model.bim cannot express directLake partitions)
model.bim MUST use compatibilityLevel 1604 and powerBI_V3
After creation, call refresh to frame Direct Lake: fabio semantic-model refresh
Call takeover to make editable in portal: fabio semantic-model takeover
definition.pbism is ALWAYS required regardless of format

Introspect a model's schema WITHOUT parsing its definition via DAX INFO.VIEW.* (the Analysis Services Schema Rowsets): list-tables (StorageMode incl. Direct Lake), list-columns (DataType/SummarizeBy/FormatString), list-measures (Expression/FormatString), list-relationships (Cardinality/CrossFilteringBehavior). Use these before writing DAX or wiring a report.

Enhanced/granular refresh: 'refresh --objects '[{"table":"Sales"}]'' refreshes specific tables/partitions (TMSL refresh semantics); add --commit-mode transactional|partialBatch, --max-parallelism, --retry-count. Registers as ViaEnhancedApi. Monitor with refresh-details --refresh-id <requestId> (object-level status) and stop with cancel-refresh --refresh-id <requestId>; get the requestId from refresh-status.
